instruction: From the attached document in the newest email in Notes, extract the second image and save it to /home/user/Desktop/saved_image2.png

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting the 2nd image from the Word document attached in the most recent email in Notes folder and saving it to /home/user/Desktop/saved_image2.png. Verified by checking the saved image has correct dimensions (1114x623 pixels) from the actual document attachment in the Thunderbird profile.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks if image file exists at target path with expected dimensions (1114x623 ±5px)
Getter properly extracts image properties using PIL with appropriate error handling and cleanup
Metric correctly handles 'type: rule' parameter - directly accesses expected['exists'], expected['width'], expected['height'] without incorrect .get('rules') pattern
Expected dimensions (1114x623) appear to be from actual document analysis, providing unique fingerprint for the second image
Good edge case handling: file not found, PIL errors, missing properties

Minor weakness: Evaluator uses indirect verification (dimension matching) rather than directly verifying it's the second image from the correct email, but dimension uniqueness provides sufficient semantic verification in practice
